definitions.certified: A positive property is counted only if all required saved obligations replay with the expected SAT/UNSAT result.
definitions.original_verified: Programs marked verified in the corresponding k-prefix verification record; no verification outcome is changed.
definitions.population: All counts use the selected program population; --limit/--keys produce a subset, not the full benchmark.
definitions.comparison: Same semantic engine and budgets as the hidden audit. No extra predecessor search or longer replay timeout is used.
